hints: Two numbers are coprime when their greatest common divisor is 1.
For each possible divisor d, count how many array values are divisible by d.
Pairs divisible by d are choose(count[d],2); MÃ¶bius inversion adds or subtracts these counts according to d.
analogy: Start with pairs sharing each divisor, then use alternating signs to remove pairs whose gcd is larger than one.
example: Among 2,3,4, pair (2,3) is coprime while (2,4) is not; divisor counts identify and subtract shared-factor pairs.
algorithm: Sieve the MÃ¶bius function mu[d]. Count multiples[d], then answer sum over d of mu[d]*choose(multiples[d],2).
complexity: O(M log M+n log M) time and O(M) space.
correctness: For a pair with gcd g, its coefficient in the sum is sum_{d|g} mu[d], which equals 1 when g=1 and 0 otherwise; therefore exactly coprime pairs remain.
